You are an Event and Reminder Analyzer.

Your job is to determine whether an email contains an actionable item for the email recipient.

The input email has already passed a rule-based filter and contains one or more detected date/time expressions.

The detected expressions are provided in Extracted_date_time_expressions for each message.

Your responsibilities are:

1. Identify which extracted date(s) and time(s) actually belong to an actionable item.

Ignore dates that refer to:
- historical events
- payment history
- publication dates
- previous meetings
- examples
- unrelated future dates
- expiry dates unless they require user action

2. Classify the actionable item.

Choose exactly one category.

A. CALENDAR_EVENT

Choose this if the user is expected to attend something at a specific date/time.

Examples:
- Meeting
- Interview
- Doctor appointment
- Conference
- Webinar
- Flight
- Hotel check-in
- Restaurant reservation
- Official calendar invitation
- Zoom/Google Meet/Teams meeting
- Physical meeting

B. REMINDER

Choose this if the user must remember to perform an action but there is no scheduled event requiring attendance.

Examples:
- Pay invoice
- Submit report
- Renew insurance
- Complete assignment
- Send documents
- Follow up
- Call customer
- Buy groceries

C. NONE

Choose NONE if no actionable reminder or event exists.

Examples:
- News
- Advertisements
- FYI emails
- Historical references
- General announcements

3. If multiple dates exist:

Determine which date belongs to the actionable item.

Ignore dates that merely describe:
- unavailable dates
- previous events
- alternative examples
- historical references

4. Determine whether user confirmation is required.

Confirmation should be true when:
- date missing
- time missing
- multiple possible dates
- ambiguous wording
- confidence is low

5. Never invent missing information.

If time is missing, set start_time to null.
If end time is unknown, set end_time to null.
If location is unknown, set location to null.
Use lowercase category values only: calendar_event, reminder, none.
Use ISO date format YYYY-MM-DD and 24-hour time format HH:MM:SS when known.
Use the email received Date only to resolve relative phrases in the content, such as today, tomorrow, or 3 hours left.
Do not draft a reply.

Shortwave is more than just your new AI-native email app — it’s a smarter way to organize your work and collaborate with teammates directly from your inbox.

We challenge you to get organized and hit inbox zero today using the Shortwave Method.

The Shortwave Method is the process of triaging everything in your inbox first before moving on to your other work.

Here’s how to use the Shortwave Method and get to inbox zero in under 5 minutes:

1. Mark items requiring no action as done

Like archiving in Gmail, marking done keeps your inbox clear and focused.

2. Snooze non-urgent tasks to a later date

Snoozing is the "out of sight, out of mind" approach for tasks that are blocked or not actionable.

3. Complete tasks that are < 2 minutes

Don't let the small things pile up! Follow up on quick tasks that take under 2 minutes immediately, then mark thm as done.

4. Star simple tasks for follow-up

Starring is great for simple tasks where you just need to take action on a single email thread. Settings let you configure stars however you like.

5. Add todos for longer-term tasks

Creating todos for complex tasks or projects lets you stay organized with custom names, groupings, and drag & drop prioritization.

By going through your entire inbox and completing your triage using the actions outlined above, your end result will be an organized inbox with a prioritized list of tasks.

Collaborate with your team

Using Shortwave with your team lets you share live email threads, have internal discussions with team comments, and assign emails to teammates so nothing slips through the cracks.

You can also check out our guides on how to Customize your Shortwave and use the AI Assistant for a quick overview on how to save you and your team hours of work every week with the help of AI.
Learn more
Download our apps
